name: Dual Enrollment (New River Community College)
what_you_do: Take college courses while in high school for credit on both your high school and college transcripts. Classes are taught in partnership with local high schools.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors who go to a high school in the NRCC service region. You must meet college placement rules. You need a note of support from a high school official and a signed form from a parent. Strong freshmen and sophomores may be able to join. They need the OK of the high school principal and the college president.
deadline_text: The page links to a dual enrollment calendars page. No dates are listed on this page.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school counselor and use the dual enrollment forms on the NRCC page. The parent signature form is required.
notes: The NRCC page still showed an old campus closure banner, so confirm the details with the college. Cost to students is not stated on the page.
